name: Orofacial Clefting-Cardiac Anomalies-Facial Dysmorphism Syndrome
aliases: Orofacial Clefting with Congenital Heart Defects and Facial Dysmorphism

diagnosticCriteria.formalCriteriaName: Orofacial Clefting-Cardiac Anomalies-Facial Dysmorphism Syndrome Diagnostic Criteria

criteria.description: Presence of orofacial clefting including cleft lip and/or cleft palate
Congenital cardiac anomalies such as atrial septal defect, ventricular septal defect, or tetralogy of Fallot
Characteristic facial dysmorphic features including hypertelorism, broad nasal bridge, and micrognathia
Postnatal growth retardation or failure to thrive
Mild to moderate developmental delay or intellectual disability

diagnosticCriteria.minimumForDiagnosis: Presence of all three major criteria: orofacial clefting, congenital cardiac anomalies, and characteristic facial dysmorphism
diagnosticCriteria.notes: Diagnosis is clinical; genetic testing may support but is not definitive.

searchTerms: split lip or cleft palate at birth
birth defect of lip and/or roof of mouth
facial clefting involving lip or palate
holes in heart walls present at birth

pathognomonic.symptomName: Facial dysmorphism including hypertelorism and broad nasal bridge
searchTerms: wide spaced eyes and broad nose bridge
distinct facial features with wide eyes
unusual facial shape with broad nose

occasional.symptomName: Hearing impairment due to recurrent otitis media

laboratory: Thyroid function tests may reveal hypothyroidism in rare cases
imaging: Echocardiogram showing septal defects or other cardiac anomalies
Craniofacial imaging demonstrating cleft lip/palate and facial bone abnormalities
other: Audiological evaluation may reveal conductive hearing loss
Developmental assessments for cognitive and speech delays

distinguishingFeatures: 22q11.2 deletion confirmed by FISH or microarray
Palatal abnormalities with distinct facial features

redFlags: Severe congenital heart defects requiring urgent intervention
Airway obstruction due to orofacial anomalies
Failure to thrive with feeding difficulties
